faqs.q: Sec. 6-165. - Transfer of ownership; promotional association structure change.
faqs.a:
(a)
In general.
Applications to change the composition of the board of directors of a certified promotional
               association shall be made upon forms provided by the city clerk. The certified promotional
               association shall submit the name and address of each director to the city clerk within
               28 days of such a change. The city clerk may refuse to authorize a change in the certified
               promotional association membership for any of the reasons listed in
sections 6-169
and
6-171
. The city clerk may bring a change in composition application to a public hearing
               in front of the authority at the city clerk's discretion. A public hearing shall be
               held in accordance with
section 6-164
.
(b)
New attachment.
If the attachment of a new liquor licensed establishment to a previously approved
               promotional association changes, alters, or modifies the common consumption area,
section 6-166
must be followed. The city clerk may approve the attachment of a new liquor licensed
               establishment to a previously certified promotional association and approved common
               consumption area without a public hearing provided that:
(1)
The common consumption area is not changed, modified, or altered;
(2)
The new member obtains permission to attach to the common consumption area from the
               promotional association; and
(3)
The new member has received a valid liquor license from the authority and the state.
(c)
Nontransferable.
No license granted pursuant to this article shall be transferable from one person
               or entity to another.
(
Ord. No. 4804
, § 1, 6-6-2022)
